preconditions.description: The input integers a (even count) and b (odd count) are between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The parsed input values a and b are integers.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists an interval [l, r] with exactly a even and b odd numbers, which occurs if and only if the absolute difference between a and b is at most 1; otherwise output 'NO'.
